$doc: Candidate vLLM serving configuration. The trusted GB10 runner fetches this file at your submitted commit, validates it against a strict whitelist, deploys it as the candidate engine, and measures it paired against the pinned baseline. Empty overrides reproduce the baseline. Allowed keys: maxNumSeqs (1-8), maxNumBatchedTokens (512-16384), enforceEager (bool), compilationLevel (0-3), attentionBackend (FLASHINFER|FLASH_ATTN|TRITON_ATTN), speculative ({model: pinned Poolside DFlash NVFP4 id, numSpeculativeTokens: 1-15} or draftless {method: "ngram", numSpeculativeTokens: 1-15, promptLookupMax: 1-8}). Exact greedy output must survive: a config that flips any token is rejected.
